themes.name: Animal Facts
themes.description: Fascinating facts about wildlife with hyper-realistic AI video
themes.content_prompt: Generate ONE fascinating, little-known fact about {animal}. Start with 'Did you know'. Keep it under 100 words. Make it surprising and shareable. Include a specific number or stat if possible.
themes.animal_prompt: Pick ONE random animal that would make a visually stunning short video. Choose from: mammals, birds, marine life, reptiles, insects. Return JSON: {"name": "Animal Name", "habitat": "Where it lives", "visual_style": "how it looks/moves"}
themes.visual_style: hyper-realistic, nature documentary quality, cinematic 4K, detailed textures, natural lighting
themes.sora_template: Hyper-realistic {animal} {visual_style}. Nature documentary style, 4K cinematic quality, smooth motion, {habitat} environment. No text, no humans.
